mapper.select: SELECT u.user_idx, u.user_id, u.user_name, u.user_birthdate, u.user_tel, u.user_email, u.role_idx, m.user_intro, m.profile_img FROM usertb u LEFT JOIN mypage m ON u.user_idx = m.user_idx WHERE u.user_id = #{user_id}
select * from schedule where user_idx=#{user_idx} and to_char(s_start_date,'yyyy-mm')=#{year}||'-'||lpad(#{month},2,'0')

select to_char(paidat,'yyyy-mm-dd') as "date", count(paymentid) as "usage_count", sum(paid) as "total_amount" from studycafe_pay where pay_status='paid' and user_idx=#{user_idx} and paidat>=sysdate-30 group by to_char(paidat,'yyyy-mm-dd') order by "date" asc
mapper.insert: insert into wish_list values( wish_list_idx.nextval, #{w_target_type}, sysdate, #{w_target_idx}, #{user_idx} )
mapper.select: select s.*, u.user_name, m.profile_img from wish_list w join study s on w.w_target_idx=s.study_idx join usertb u on s.user_idx=u.user_idx left join mypage m on u.user_idx=m.user_idx where w.user_idx=#{user_idx} and w.w_target_type='스터디' order by w.wish_idx desc

select m.*, u.user_name, p.profile_img from wish_list w join mento_profile m on w.w_target_idx=m.mentor_idx join usertb u on m.user_idx=u.user_idx left join mypage p on u.user_idx=p.user_idx where w.user_idx=#{user_idx} and w.w_target_type='멘토링' order by w.wish_idx desc

SELECT study_title, TO_CHAR(study_start_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as study_start_date, TO_CHAR(study_end_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as study_end_date FROM study WHERE user_idx = #{user_idx} UNION SELECT s.study_title, TO_CHAR(s.study_start_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as study_start_date, TO_CHAR(s.study_end_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as study_end_date FROM study_application sa JOIN study s ON sa.study_idx = s.study_idx WHERE sa.user_idx = #{user_idx} AND sa.sa_status = 'Approved'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studycafe_pay p JOIN studycafe_ticket st ON p.orderName = st.ticket_name WHERE p.user_idx = #{user_idx} AND p.pay_status = 'PAID'
AND p.paid < st.ticket_amount AND p.paidAt >= #{membershipDate}
SELECT mentor_idx FROM mentoring_match WHERE mentee_user_idx = #{user_idx} AND status = '매칭됨'
